evals.prompt: `pnpm typecheck` is failing with TS5110 on `packages/m3l-analytics/tsconfig.json`. The error message says option 'module' must be set to 'NodeNext' when option 'moduleResolution' is set to 'Bundler'. What is wrong and how do I fix it?

evals.prompt: Can I set `"declaration": false` in `packages/m3l-analytics/tsconfig.build.json` to stop emitting `.d.ts` files? We don't publish this package externally so we don't need them.
